delivery.outcome: Make terminal pull-request review reruns neutral before ticket resolution while preserving complete fail-closed governance for every open pull request.
nonGoals: Do not relax ticket ownership, intent, scope or approval checks for an open pull request
Do not repin adopter repositories or repair the historical todo2code run
Do not create a release, tag or cleanup commit

architecture.decision: Acquire a closed live PR-state snapshot in the protected workflow, validate its repository/number/head bindings with a deterministic standard runtime, and gate diff ownership plus approval only when the validated result is enforce; terminal results emit a neutral success and unknown states fail closed.
interfaceChanges: The reusable governance workflow now distinguishes live open and terminal pull-request states before diff enforcement
dataChanges: A runner-temporary closed PR-state snapshot and gate output are introduced
architecture.rollback: Before merge, revert the atomic ticket commit; after merge, publish a corrective standard commit while retaining open-PR fail-closed behavior.

validation.evidence: Open, terminal and malformed snapshot fixtures plus workflow structure assertions pass deterministically.

commands: for test_script in tests/*.test.sh; do bash "$test_script"; done
validation.evidence: The complete standard suite and exact-range governance gate pass.
